definitions.explanation: An eyelid that has a visible horizontal fold or crease above the lashes, making the upper eye area look as if it has two layers. The opposite of {一重|ひとえ}まぶた. A central concept in Japanese discussions of eye shape, makeup, and cosmetic surgery.

examples.japanese: ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な{二重|ふたえ}まぶた。
{二重|ふたえ}まぶた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{整形手術|せいけいしゅじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people undergo cosmetic surgery to get double eyelids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{二重|ふたえ}まぶたになっていること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes when I wake up in the morning, only one of my eyelids has a double-fold.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ (double layer, two-fold) and まぶた (eyelid). Describes an eyelid with a distinct crease above the lash line. Note that ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ in this word is read ふたえ — not にじゅう, which would be the more general reading of the same kanji.

USAGE:
- Used attributively ({二重|ふたえ}まぶた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ "eyes with double eyelids") and as a predicate (⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二重|ふたえ}まぶただ "She has double eyelids").
- In casual conversation, many speakers drop まぶた and just say ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧: ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ (beautiful double eyelids).
- Commonly paired with its opposite ⟦{一重|ひとえ}まぶた→一重まぶた：23271_hitoemabuta⟧ (single eyelid).
- An unusual in-between category is ⟦{奥二重|おくぶたえ}→奥二重：29807_okubutae⟧ — a crease that is partly hidden behind the upper lid.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Double eyelids are considered a desirable feature in mainstream Japanese beauty culture, and the industry around creating them is enormous: drugstore products like アイプチ (eyelid glue) and アイテープ (eyelid tape), as well as surgical procedures known as ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧, are widely advertised. Many adults describe fluctuating eyelid shape — especially having ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ on swollen mornings or after sleeping poorly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二重|ふたえ}まぶた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give oneself double eyelids (via makeup or surgery)
- {二重|ふたえ}まぶた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become double (naturally or otherwise)
- {二重|ふたえ}まぶた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: the crease line of a double eyelid
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な{二重|ふたえ}まぶた: natural-looking double eyelids
- {二重|ふたえ}まぶた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧: double-eyelid cosmetic surgery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}まぶた→一重まぶた：23271_hitoemabuta⟧: single eyelid — the opposite shape, without a crease
- ⟦{奥二重|おくぶたえ}→奥二重：29807_okubutae⟧: hidden double eyelid — a crease that is mostly concealed
- まぶた: eyelid — the base noun
- アイプチ: eyelid glue — a drugstore product used to create a temporary double eyelid
- ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧: double-eyelid surgery — the cosmetic procedure
